neighbour_own_lcs.note: QLP/eleanor flux fractions use the S13 PRF scene (TESS_PRF at Gaia positions, field registration); 'decontaminated' = depth after removing all flux except the named star's own, i.e. what a contamination-corrected light curve of that star would show.

comparison_with_transit_folder.note: Comparison made AFTER all psf_photometry numbers were produced (independence rule).

localisation.comment: transit/prf_localize.py places the source between the stars (E 4.2, N 3.3 arcsec; 7 sigma from the neighbour). Its PRF/WCS registration was fitted on the out-of-transit image with FREE fluxes for the target and neighbour, which is degenerate with the pair centroid along the target-neighbour axis. In S104 its x-registration (along the separation, which is along -x there) differs from the field-star registration used here by ~0.24 px, while the perpendicular (y) component agrees (0.112 vs 0.105 px). With field-star registration (pair excluded) the pixel-map source is 0.9 arcsec from the neighbour. transit/localize_twosource.py (ratio fixed to Gaia) agrees with this work.
